message.content:
This black and white editorial cover features a prominent red border along the left and bottom edges. At the top, the large white word "TEMPO" is centered above the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Above this, smaller text reads "INVESTIGASI: PERDAGANGAN ILEGAL TENGGILING" and "TANGKAPLAH JAKSA, KAU KULEPASKAN".

The central image depicts a person in a helmet and face mask, wearing a light-colored short-sleeved shirt and trousers. This individual leans forward, reaching towards another person who is bent over a metal railing. This second person is wearing a dark, long-sleeved hooded top and light-colored pants; their body is angled downwards, with their back toward the viewer. A thick concrete barrier is visible in the foreground. In the bottom right foreground, the back of a man’s head and shoulders are visible, wearing a dark t-shirt.

Large white text in the lower left reads "LELAKI GONDRONG DAN GLOCK 42". Below, smaller text states, "Polisi dituding melanggar prosedur dalam penanganan rusuh 22 Mei. Keterlibatan pria misterius bersenjata khusus ditelusuri." At the bottom right, date and price information is provided, along with a barcode and the numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00020".
